neighbours.label: the end of a defining clause that picks out a group by a trait ('those who have X', 'people with X', 'adults who follow X'); the same nouns outside a group-defining clause stay quiet
fire: Readers who subscribe to the print edition get a free calendar.
Those who own electric cars can charge them for free at the mall.
People with sensitive skin should avoid this soap.
Anyone who has lived through a hard winter knows the value of firewood.
Those of you with young children may want to sit near the exit.
Students who play an instrument often do well in maths.
Patients with high blood pressure should check it every week.
Those who travel often for work will like this lightweight bag.
